source_findings: EIA 2023 U.S. net generation table, https://www.eia.gov/tools/faqs/faq.php?id=427&t=3, source eia-generation-2023, offsets 635 to 1202. Pumped storage hydropower row gives -6 billion kWh and -0.1%, retained with correct sign, period and denominator.
Raw composer selected the bound table unit. The application rendered the claim without fallback or editorial correction. NeMo accepted the stored wording.
